newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Skanska 9 mo profit seen higher.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Skanska 9 mo profit seen higher.

text.p: Swedish construction and real estate group Skanska was expected to post a profit after financial items of 3.17 billion crowns for the first nine months of 1996, a Reuter poll of six analysts found.
Forecasts varied between 2.88 and 3.44 billion crowns.
In the corresponding period a year ago Skanska reported a profit after financial items of 2.16 billion crowns.
The forecasts included an estimated capital gain of about 1.7 billion crowns from, among other things, the sale of a stake in Graninge.
In addition it also included a cutback in goodwill in Skane-Gripen of 1.1 billion crowns.
The average of forecasts for calendar 1996 indicated a profit of 3.83 billion crowns against 2.59 billion crowns in full year 1995.
Skanska will present its nine month report on Friday, November 22.
Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Handelsbanken,
Carnegie, Swedbank, Enskilda, Nordiska and Aros.
